title: Family name and how he became 'Captain'
summary: Handy gives his full name and explains that A.J. Minor nicknamed him Captain after he stopped a rehearsal over bad notes.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: 19. 19-under. Did your family play actually? Everybody in my family play or something.
Yeah, I mean before you? Yeah. Did daddy play? Yeah, my daddy was in the fall once. What was his name? John Handy. John Handy. That was all of his name? He didn't have a middle name?

That's all your name, huh? No, my name is John Guy Handy, but I don't use the Guy Handy. John Handy. Somebody slipped cap in there, I mean. Yeah. Where did you get that cap? A.J. Minor. Uh-huh. How did that come about, I mean? Oh, this rehearsal was the only Pelican and I heard some bad notes and I stopped the band.

A.J. made them go over again. The next two days we had another rehearsal and I come up the steps and A.J. was playing the guitar with us and he seen me come and said, oh oh, you're coming to the captain. They've been calling the cap ever since.
